- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?
**Motivation**

MXFP8 NCCL EP Dispatch is currently not functional because the Dispatch Op outputs an MXFP8
`GroupedTensor`. `GroupedTensor` does not support `untyped_storage().resize_(0)`, and implementing
that operation does not make sense for a custom tensor with no single backing storage.

**Aims at solving 2 main problems**
1. Refactors `ScheduleNode` activation ownership so releasable inputs no longer require
`untyped_storage().resize_(0)`.
   - `self.inputs` is retained because the node still needs a source from which to retrieve input
     gradients.
   - Only inputs selected by the existing `should_free_input` policy are represented by a
     storage-free `ScheduleNodeInputWrapper`. The real detached tensor is moved into the node's
     forward graph and is released through normal Python/autograd lifetime management.
   - Inputs that are needed in backward remain ordinary detached tensor leaves, preserving the
     pre-PR behavior and avoiding wrapper/unwrap overhead on those boundaries.
   - Outputs are represented by autograd `GradientEdge`s instead of retaining output tensors.
     Transformer-layer side outputs similarly use ordinary detached leaves and producer edges.

2. Rearranges dispatch/grouped-MLP/combine ownership so `permuted_local_hidden_states` can be
garbage-collected instead of being manually released with `untyped_storage().resize_(0)`.
Fine-grained CPU offloading still force-releases ordinary tensors after offload as a precaution.
For `GroupedTensor`, it relies on garbage collection because there is no unified storage to resize.

This has been verified on the DeepSeek-V3 4-node proxy configuration with combined 1F1B overlap,
MXFP8 NCCL EP, paged stashing with TE main.

MXFP8 Dispatch is not functional on plain main, so the baseline is current main plus
[PR #7992](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7992), which has explicit `GroupedTensor`
release handling.

Steady-state performance (iterations 50-100) is equivalent: 1473.49 ms/iteration for PR #7992 and
1473.40 ms/iteration for this PR (-0.007%).

**MXFP8 Dispatch + PagedStashing**

| Metric | Case | Maximum | Delta-vs-PR7992 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `peak_alloc` | PR #7992 | **194.400 GiB** | 0.000 GiB (+0.00%) |
| `peak_alloc` | Current PR | **194.400 GiB** | 0.000 GiB (+0.00%) |
| `nonpool` | PR #7992 | **8.460 GiB** | 0.000 GiB (+0.00%) |
| `nonpool` | Current PR | **8.460 GiB** | 0.000 GiB (+0.00%) |

Both runs completed all 100 training iterations with matching loss behavior. PR #7992 then aborted
during process teardown with `free(): invalid pointer`; this PR exited cleanly.

- **New features**: a linked issue is **required**. Please open a [feature request](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) and reference it here before submitting the PR.
- **Small updates (bug fixes, minor improvements)**: a linked issue is **recommended** and will accelerate the PR review process.

Linked issue: <!-- e.g. Fixes #1234 / Related to #1234 -->

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [x] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

Feel free to message or comment @NVIDIA/mcore-oncall to help accelerate your merge into main. The less complex your PR is, the faster it will be approved and merged!

All PRs start as **draft**. If you open a non-draft PR, it will be automatically converted to draft.

#### Step 1: Mark PR as "Ready for Review"

#### Step 2: Final Review

For PRs outside `megatron/core`, this step is skipped.

+class ScheduleNodeInputWrapper(torch.Tensor):
+    """Storage-free autograd leaf for a ScheduleNode input.
+
+    Construction detaches the real input from its producer graph. Unwrapping
+    then connects that detached tensor to this storage-free leaf, creating the
+    consumer-side autograd graph boundary. After unwrapping, the wrapper retains
+    only tensor metadata and the eventual input gradient.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def __new__(cls, real_tensor):
+        assert real_tensor._base is None, "ScheduleNodeInputWrapper real tensor must be viewless"
+        wrapper = torch.Tensor._make_wrapper_subclass(
+            cls,
+            tuple(real_tensor.shape),
+            strides=tuple(real_tensor.stride()),
+            storage_offset=real_tensor.storage_offset(),
+            dtype=real_tensor.dtype,
+            layout=real_tensor.layout,
+            device=real_tensor.device,
+            requires_grad=real_tensor.requires_grad,
+        )
+        wrapper._real_tensor = real_tensor.detach().requires_grad_(real_tensor.requires_grad)
+        return wrapper
+
+    def _take_real_tensor(self):
+        """Transfer the real tensor out of this move-only wrapper."""
+        real_tensor = self._real_tensor
+        if real_tensor is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Real tensor has already been consumed")
+        self._real_tensor = None
+        return real_tensor
+
+    def unwrap_real_tensor(self):
+        """Unwrap the detached real tensor and route its gradient to this wrapper."""
+        return _UnwrapRealTensor.apply(self)
+
+    def untyped_storage(self):
+        """The wrapper itself never owns activation storage."""
+        return torch.UntypedStorage(0, device=self.device)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def __torch_dispatch__(cls, func, types, args=(), kwargs=None):
+        # The wrapper is only an autograd leaf; all model operations receive the
+        # normal tensor returned by _UnwrapRealTensor.
+        if func in (torch.ops.aten.detach.default, torch.ops.aten.alias.default):
+            wrapper = args[0]
+            out = torch.Tensor._make_wrapper_subclass(
+                cls,
+                tuple(wrapper.shape),
+                strides=tuple(wrapper.stride()),
+                storage_offset=wrapper.storage_offset(),
+                dtype=wrapper.dtype,
+                layout=wrapper.layout,
+                device=wrapper.device,
+                requires_grad=(
+                    False if func == torch.ops.aten.detach.default else wrapper.requires_grad
+                ),
+            )
+            out._real_tensor = wrapper._real_tensor
+            return out
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported operation on schedule-node input wrapper: {func}")
+
+
+class _UnwrapRealTensor(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """Connect a wrapper leaf to its already-detached real tensor."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, wrapper):
+        """Return the real tensor while connecting it to the wrapper leaf."""
+        return wrapper._take_real_tensor()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad):
+        """Pass the real tensor's gradient back to the wrapper leaf."""
+        return grad
+

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.models.common.utils import TransformerLayerNode
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.utils import ScheduleNode, ScheduleNodeInputWrapper
+
+
+class _TestScheduleNode(ScheduleNode):
+    """ScheduleNode test double that omits event synchronization."""
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def stream_acquire_context(self, name=None):
+        yield
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="ScheduleNode requires CUDA")
+def test_input_wrapper_does_not_retain_node_inputs_or_outputs():
+    """Input wrappers preserve segmented backward without retaining real tensors."""
+    weight_1 = torch.tensor(3.0, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    weight_2 = torch.tensor(5.0, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    input_tensor = torch.tensor([2.0, 4.0], device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    node_2_backward_called = False
+
+    def backward(output_edges, output_grads):
+        torch.autograd.backward(output_edges, grad_tensors=output_grads)
+        return output_grads
+
+    def node_2_backward(output_edges, output_grads):
+        nonlocal node_2_backward_called
+        node_2_backward_called = True
+        return backward(output_edges, output_grads)
+
+    stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+    node_1 = _TestScheduleNode(
+        lambda tensor: tensor * weight_1,
+        stream=stream,
+        event=None,
+        backward_func=backward,
+        free_input=True,
+        name="node_1",
+    )
+    node_2 = _TestScheduleNode(
+        lambda tensor: tensor * weight_2,
+        stream=stream,
+        event=None,
+        backward_func=node_2_backward,
+        free_input=True,
+        name="node_2",
+    )
+
+    intermediate = node_1.forward(input_tensor)
+    output = node_2.forward(intermediate)
+
+    assert type(intermediate) is torch.Tensor
+    assert type(output) is torch.Tensor
+
+    # Each node retains only its storage-free input-gradient leaf.
+    node_1_wrapper = node_1.inputs[0]
+    node_2_wrapper = node_2.inputs[0]
+    assert node_1_wrapper._real_tensor is None
+    assert node_2_wrapper._real_tensor is None
+    assert node_1_wrapper.shape == input_tensor.shape
+    assert node_2_wrapper.shape == input_tensor.shape
+    assert node_1_wrapper.untyped_storage().nbytes() == 0
+    assert node_2_wrapper.untyped_storage().nbytes() == 0
+    assert len(node_1._output_edges) == 1
+    assert len(node_2._output_edges) == 1
+
+    node_2_input_grad = node_2.backward(torch.ones_like(output))
+    assert node_2_backward_called
+    assert node_2.inputs is None
+    assert torch.equal(node_2_input_grad, torch.full_like(input_tensor, 5.0))
+    assert torch.equal(weight_2.grad, torch.full_like(weight_2, 18.0))
+    assert weight_1.grad is None
+
+    node_1_input_grad = node_1.backward(node_2_input_grad)
+    assert node_1.inputs is None
+    assert torch.equal(node_1_input_grad, torch.full_like(input_tensor, 15.0))
+    assert torch.equal(weight_1.grad, torch.full_like(weight_1, 30.0))
+    # The first boundary deliberately stops traversal into the caller's graph.
+    assert input_tensor.grad is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="ScheduleNode requires CUDA")
+def test_retained_input_uses_an_ordinary_detached_leaf():
+    """Non-releasable boundaries retain input storage without wrapper dispatch."""
+    weight = torch.tensor(3.0, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    input_tensor = torch.tensor([2.0, 4.0], device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    node = _TestScheduleNode(
+        lambda tensor: tensor * weight,
+        stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        event=None,
+        free_input=False,
+    )
+
+    output = node.forward(input_tensor)
+    grad_source = node.inputs[0]
+    assert type(grad_source) is torch.Tensor
+    assert not isinstance(grad_source, ScheduleNodeInputWrapper)
+    assert grad_source.is_leaf
+    assert grad_source.untyped_storage().nbytes() == input_tensor.untyped_storage().nbytes()
+
+    input_grad = node.backward(torch.ones_like(output))
+    assert torch.equal(input_grad, torch.full_like(input_tensor, 3.0))
+    assert torch.equal(weight.grad, torch.full_like(weight, 6.0))
+    assert input_tensor.grad is None
+
+
+def test_side_output_uses_an_ordinary_detached_leaf():
+    """Side-output gradients cross the node boundary without another wrapper node."""
+    input_tensor = torch.tensor([2.0, 4.0], requires_grad=True)
+    produced = input_tensor * 2.0
+    node = object.__new__(TransformerLayerNode)
+    node.detached = tuple()
+    node.before_detached = tuple()
+
+    detached = node.detach(produced)
+    assert type(detached) is torch.Tensor
+    assert not isinstance(detached, ScheduleNodeInputWrapper)
+    assert detached.is_leaf
+
+    (detached * 3.0).sum().backward()
+    detached_grads = node.backward_impl(tuple(), tuple())
+
+    assert torch.equal(detached_grads[0], torch.full_like(input_tensor, 3.0))
+    assert torch.equal(input_tensor.grad, torch.full_like(input_tensor, 6.0))
+    assert node.detached == tuple()
+    assert node.before_detached == tuple()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="ScheduleNode requires CUDA")
+def test_backward_ignores_non_differentiable_outputs():
+    """Output gradients remain positionally aligned when an output has no autograd edge."""
+    weight = torch.tensor(3.0, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    input_tensor = torch.tensor([2.0, 4.0], device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    node = _TestScheduleNode(
+        lambda tensor: (tensor * weight, tensor.detach()),
+        stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        event=None,
+    )
+
+    differentiable_output, detached_output = node.forward(input_tensor)
+    assert node._output_edges[0] is not None
+    assert node._output_edges[1] is None
+
+    input_grad = node.backward(
+        (torch.ones_like(differentiable_output), torch.ones_like(detached_output))
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(input_grad, torch.full_like(input_tensor, 3.0))
+    assert torch.equal(weight.grad, torch.full_like(weight, 6.0))
